mapper.select: SELECT r.*, s.scenario_name FROM stress_test_result r LEFT JOIN stress_test_scenario s ON r.scenario_id = s.scenario_id WHERE r.test_date = #{testDate} ORDER BY r.result_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stress_test_result (scenario_id, test_date, portfolio_type, baseline_loss, stressed_loss, loss_increase, loss_increase_rate, capital_impact, capital_ratio_after, pass_fail) VALUES (#{scenarioId}, #{testDate}, #{portfolioType}, #{baselineLoss}, #{stressedLoss}, #{lossIncrease}, #{lossIncreaseRate}, #{capitalImpact}, #{capitalRatioAfter}, #{passFail})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stress_test_result WHERE result_id IN #{id}
